text: Built-in SSH client using an embedded SSH library for ad-hoc connections to remote hosts, with native tabs
quote: wezterm uses an embedded ssh library to provide an integrated SSH client. The client can be used to make ad-hoc SSH connections to remote hosts

text: Connects to serial ports for embedded and Arduino work
quote: Connect to serial ports for embedded/Arduino work

text: Multiplexes terminal panes, tabs and windows on local and remote hosts, with native mouse and scrollback
quote: Multiplex terminal panes, tabs and windows on local and remote hosts, with native mouse and scrollback

text: Local terminal multiplexing with features similar to tmux or screen
quote: you can enable local terminal multiplexing with features similar to those in tmux or screen.

text: Split panes horizontally or vertically and move between them with keyboard shortcuts
quote: Splits/Panes (Split horizontally/vertically: Ctrl-Shift-Alt-% and Ctrl-Shift-Alt-", move between panes: Ctrl-Shift-ArrowKey)

text: Searchable scrollback with a keyboard-activated search mode and mouse-wheel or key navigation
quote: Searchable Scrollback (use mouse wheel and `Shift-PageUp` and `Shift PageDown` to navigate, Ctrl-Shift-F to activate search mode)

text: Quick Select mode highlights commonly copied text patterns and copies a match after you type a short prefix
quote: Quick Select mode allows you to quickly highlight text that matches commonly copied patterns, select a match by typing a one-or-two character prefix and copy it to the clipboard.

text: Watches the config file and reloads it automatically when it changes, and a shortcut can force a reload
quote: if/when it changes, the configuration will be automatically reloaded... You may also use the CTRL+SHIFT+R keyboard shortcut to force the configuration to be reloaded.

text: CLI subcommand controls a running GUI or multiplexer instance to spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes
quote: The _cli_ subcommand interacts with a running wezterm GUI or multiplexer instance, and can be used to spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes.

text: SSH domains connect to a remote wezterm multiplexer over SSH
quote: A connection to a remote wezterm multiplexer made via an ssh connection is referred to as an _SSH domain_.

text: Connecting to a remote wezterm instance preserves your tabs
quote: Take a look at the multiplexing section for an alternative configuration that connects to a remote wezterm instance and preserves your tabs.

text: SSH domains auto-populate from ~/.ssh/config
quote: Ssh_domains now auto-populate from your `~/.ssh/config` file.

text: Parses ~/.ssh/config and /etc/ssh/ssh_config and respects their options
quote: wezterm is now able to parse `~/.ssh/config` and `/etc/ssh/ssh_config` and respects the following options

text: New tabs and panes reuse the existing SSH session as new channels, so there is no re-authentication
quote: Creating new tabs or panes will each create a new channel in your existing session so you won't need to re-authenticate for additional tabs

text: Unix domains work on all systems, including Windows, to connect the native GUI to WSL
quote: Unix domains are supported on all systems, even Windows and are a way to connect the native win32 GUI into the Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL).

text: New tabs inherit the current tab's working directory when it has been set via OSC 7
quote: When the current working directory has been set via OSC 7, spawning a new tab will use the current working directory of the current tab, so that you don't have to manually change the directory

text: Supports font ligatures, color emoji and font fallback
quote: Ligatures, Color Emoji and font fallback, with true color and dynamic color schemes

text: Supports true color and dynamic color schemes
quote: Ligatures, Color Emoji and font fallback, with true color and dynamic color schemes.

text: Displays inline images via the iTerm2-compatible image protocol and Kitty graphics, with a built-in imgcat command
quote: iTerm2 compatible image protocol support, and built-in imgcat command; Kitty graphics support

text: The imgcat image output command lets you specify the display width
quote: Output an image to the terminal ... Specify the display width; defaults to "auto"

text: Installable on macOS through Homebrew as a cask
quote: $ brew install --cask wezterm

text: Configuration values can be overridden from the command line
quote: wezterm allows overriding configuration values via the command line

text: Shell integration provides a function for setting custom user vars
quote: The shell integration provides a shell function named __wezterm_set_user_var which can be used to set your own user vars.

text: Shell integration information can be used to customize tab titles and the status area
quote: You may wish to use this information to adjust what is shown in your tab titles or in the status area.

text: Runs on Linux, macOS, Windows 10, FreeBSD and NetBSD
quote: Runs on Linux, macOS, Windows 10, FreeBSD and NetBSD

text: SGR-style mouse reporting that works in vim and tmux
quote: SGR style mouse reporting (works in vim and tmux)

text: Renders underline, double underline, italic, bold and strikethrough attributes
quote: Render underline, double-underline, italic, bold, strikethrough (most other terminal emulators do not support as many render attributes)

text: Configured through a .wezterm.lua file in your home directory
quote: Create a file named `.wezterm.lua` in your home directory

text: Options such as transparency can be overridden on a per-window basis
quote: That's useful for eg: setting transparency or any other arbitrary option on a per-window basis.

text: Portable mode looks for the config file next to wezterm.exe so it can run from a thumb drive
quote: to support users that carry their wezterm application and configuration around on a thumb drive, wezterm will look for the config file in the same location as wezterm.exe

text: Jump through scrollback to the start of earlier commands and select a command's complete output
quote: jumping through the scrollback to the start of an earlier command, or conveniently selecting the complete output from a command.

text: Ships as a macOS Universal binary for Apple Silicon and Intel
quote: WezTerm is a Universal binary with support for both Apple Silicon and Intel hardware.

text: GPU-accelerated terminal emulator and multiplexer
quote: A GPU-accelerated cross-platform terminal emulator and multiplexer
